text_block_list.name: Young Rose
text_block_list.text:
“Mo—um, Mother. Until I fall asleep... would you
tell me that story again? The tale of the Kingdom of Roses...”

text_block_list.name: Rose's Mother
text_block_list.text: “Oh, Rose... Did you take a liking to that story?”

text_block_list.name: Young Rose
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, very much so...! Because it is truly wonderful.
We share a grand, magnificent dream passed down through generations—”

text_block_list.name: Young Rose
text_block_list.text:
“And there are those beside us, devoting everything to make that dream come true.
I believe that is something truly wonderful... and something to be deeply cherished.”

text_block_list.name: Young Rose
text_block_list.text:
"I want to be able to run soon, too.
To run, and run, and win so many times, and then—"

text_block_list.name: Young Rose
text_block_list.text:
"A kingdom where everyone precious to me can live smiling forever.
I want to become someone who can build that, too!"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
All for the House of the Rose—and for my great ambition.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: The curse of thorns... I swear that I will sever it once and for all—!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(! Goodness, it was meant to be just a brief rest...
To think I inadvertently fell asleep.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...I must go.
I have... a mountain of things I must accomplish—!

—Rose Kingdom leads an immensely busy life day after day.
For starters, she practically never misses her early morning training.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
! ...Good morning.
You came.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Regarding my question the other day... You may take a leave
from your trainer duties until you reach an answer about your own will.
choice_data_list: No... I would like to rethink it as we continue.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see... Understood. Then I shall run another lap or two,
so please time me. We can wrap up after that.
choice_data_list: You are wrapping things up a bit early today, I see.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I would like to make a bit more headway on my math preparation. Furthermore,
an invitation to a dinner banquet has arrived, so I must look it over and reply.

Further refining the culture and refinement she had mastered to an exceptionally high standard since childhood.
She also continued to dutifully shoulder her responsibility as the next leader of the Rose Clan.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Rose-san! Good work today.
Did you just wrap up your afternoon training?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: If you like, shall we invite Flash-san and play a game after this? It seems Ruler-san acquired a rather intriguing board game—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the invitation. But... forgive me.
Please, enjoy the games amongst yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I must depart for a soirée immediately after this.

text_block_list.name: Soirée Guest A
text_block_list.text:
Lady Rose Kingdom! It is an honor to meet you. At long last...
your challenge for the Twinkle Series begins, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Soirée Guest B
text_block_list.text:
First and foremost, I pray for your safety and great success.
Please demonstrate the pride and strength of the Rose Clan to your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes, without fail.
First, I must debut, rack up victories, and earn the right—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: And without fail, I shall deliver the House of the Rose its first GⅠ victory in history.

text_block_list.name: Soirée Guests
text_block_list.text: Ooooh...!!

—The Rose Clan has produced numerous renowned horse girls over the years.
Their racing records are undeniably brilliant in their own right. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Today of all days—today, GⅠ glory shall be ours!!
The Kingdom of Roses, right here... Aaaaagh! Ahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...!! *pant*, *gasp*, *pant*...
Khhh... damn it...!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I didn't... make it—!! Again... Again, so close!!
Just a little more... Just a tiny bit more... and yet—!!

The pinnacle stage of the Twinkle Series, the GⅠ race.
That solitary crown was the one prize that had continued to elude her, falling short by a single, agonizing step.

It was as if the Rose Clan were bound by a curse,
forever denied victory in GⅠ races—such whispers had begun to linger long ago.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —It is true that we have suffered one agonizing defeat after another.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yet every time, we of the Rose Clan took the hands of those who faithfully served as our comrades,
and rose to our feet again and again.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because I take pride in that history and those days.
Here and now, I make my solemn vow.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I shall sever the curse of thorns.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Overcoming countless heartaches—I swear I shall bring our true, magnificent bloom to life.
Applause envelops the venue. Some are even moved to tears. ...Watching her receive it all with such majestic poise—my fists clench tight before I know it.
choice_data_list: (That's right... She has always been like this.)

text_block_list.text:
Having opened the car door, I welcomed Rose Kingdom after the evening gala had concluded.
Yet before stepping inside, she gave an instruction.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Rather than the Ritto Dormitory,
please head toward a location with a nearby training course.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Please. I have brought a change of clothes.

Either way, there is barely an hour left until curfew.
Even so, that is what Rose Kingdom desires.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Hah, hah...! Hah, hah...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: HaaaAAAHHHH—!!

Without uttering a single word of pain or hardship, she continues to run.
Proudly bearing immense expectations and duty upon those small shoulders.
Rose Kingdom had always been that way—since long ago.

And so, I had watched her live each day with such earnest, diligent devotion all this time.
—Only from afar, of course. For I was in no position to call out to her.

It had sprouted—a clear, unmistakable resolve.
One day, without fail—
choice_data_list: (I wanted to become someone who could support her.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Haah...!! Haah, haah......
Forgive me... for keeping you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
In the first place... the hour is late. I should never have made you accompany me.
I truly am... lacking in consideration. Forgive me.
choice_data_list: No. I will gladly follow you, now and always.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...? What you have there, is that—
choice_data_list: This is the path I desire, Lord Rose.

text_block_list.text:
—Still, if serving by her side has taught me anything,
it's that our Lady of Roses is a worrier to an almost absurd degree.

With a wry smile suggesting that being too kind might only invite trouble,
they bowed respectfully before speaking.
choice_data_list: To help you understand, I have one request.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: A favor...?
